findings.title: Drawer-name regex is narrower than the Goals claim
findings.detail: Goals say "any `:NAME:` … `:END:` drawer", but `^\s*:[A-Z_]+:\s*$` misses lowercase names and names containing digits or hyphens. Org drawer names allow those characters, and `:END:` is matched case-insensitively. Either widen the pattern, for example `[\w-]+` with the `:END:` case handled explicitly, or say in Design that only upper-case names are covered.

findings.title: A stray `:END:` matches the opener pattern
findings.detail: `:END:` itself matches `^\s*:[A-Z_]+:\s*$`. A lone `:END:` outside any drawer would open a drawer and could swallow text up to the next `:END:`. State that the opener must exclude `END`.

findings.title: Unterminated-drawer rule is not bounded by headlines
findings.detail: The body spans a whole subtree. An unterminated `:LOGBOOK:` followed by `** Summary` and then a later drawer's `:END:` would pair up and delete the Summary heading and text. "Next `:END:`" should stop at the next org headline (or a blank line). Add that to the Design and add a test for it, since the Goals say the headings must stay.

findings.title: Planning-line behaviour is only partly tested
findings.detail: The Test plan covers a CLOSED line but not SCHEDULED or DEADLINE. It also doesn't cover a `CLOSED:` line inside a src block, which Design says is never touched. Add those cases. Say how the `test_explore.py` test produces a clocked LOGBOOK entry, since `add_idea` alone creates only PROPERTIES.

findings.title: Unterminated src/example blocks are not specified
findings.detail: The Design doesn't say how strip_drawers finds src/example blocks when one has no `#+end_`. Reusing `_block_end` and `_ORG_BLOCK_OPEN_RE` from org_markup.py would keep it consistent with `from_org_body`, which treats that case as ordinary text.
